ando1.description: If Ando uses Flash Step while Uncharged, he becomes invulnerable to non-strategic skills for 1 turn.

ando2.description: When Ando uses Focus Power, he gains 5 DR for 2 turns for each target marked by Electroblade.

ando3.description: Expel Energy also marks its target and another random target with Electroblade.

ando4.description: Overclock is now permanent, but Ando receives 15 Affliction damage when he uses a Supercharged ability.

ando5.description: While Ando is Charged or Supercharged, he ignores Counters and Reflects.

aramao1.description: Sand Quake's cost is reduced by 1 [65], but Desert Veil only applies Veiled for 1 turn.

aramao2.description: If Mirage Trap expires without being triggered, the affected enemy heals the allied Hero directly across from them for 25 HP.

aramao3.description: After Desert Veil finishes applying Veiled, the untargeted allied Hero is Veiled for 2 turns.

aramao4.description: If Aramao is Veiled, Desert Knife deals 10 more damage and extends the duration of his Veiled effects by 1 turn.

aramao5.description: Trial of Sands lasts 1 more turn. While it is active, all enemy Heroes are considered to be across from Aramao, and all allied Heroes are considered to be adjacent to him.

ayana1.description: The base damage reduction per ally is increased to 10

ayana2.description: Ayana gains 30 shield for 1 turn when she uses Prayer.

ayana3.description: If an enemy triggers Voice of Light, it is automatically recast on them, ignoring invulnerability and counters

ayana4.description: Prayer makes its target Invulnerable for 1 turn if used on a target below 20 HP.

ayana5.description: Prayer and Voice of Light cause 10 more healing or damage, but no longer have a secondary effect.

blackknight1.description: If the Black Knight defeats an enemy, his skills are enhanced for the following two turns

blackknight2.description: The turn after activating his passive, The Nightmare Rides costs one less [8].

blackknight3.description: Oathbreaker Strike deals 15 additional damage to the primary target if Unholy Aura is affecting more than 3 targets

blackknight4.description: If Dead or Alive successfully redirects an ability, the Black Knight gains Elemental Essence

blackknight5.description: Oathbreaker Strike deals 10 damage to the target's allies while enhanced.

dennis1.description: Dennis will automatically use HS-46 Ascendant Serum on himself any time he receives a stun effect.

dennis2.description: Dennis will automatically use HS-112 Fury Serum on himself if an allied Hero dies. If that Hero was Hector the Injector, Dennis uses End of Shift instead.

dennis3.description: Pain Tolerance now lasts for 2 turns.

dennis4.description: Shared Agony now costs 1 Generic energy, but both parts of its activation now include all allied units.

dennis5.description: Big Green Fist deals 5 more base damage, and decreases the remaining cooldown of End of Shift by 1 turn.

fate1.description: If Fate is revived using This Is Not The End, he no longer prevents healing from his allies from affecting him.

fate2.description: Will-o'-wisp no longer gives Fate's team Shield. Instead, the enemy team has their Helpful skills stunned while it is active.

fate3.description: Vulpus Incendia and Vulpus Crystallia can now be used without interrupting Channeling.

fate4.description: Enemies that don't trigger Fox's Cunning during its duration will have their cooldowns paralyzed for 2 turns.

fate5.description: This Is Not The End's trigger limit is now per allied Hero (each Hero can be revived once per round.)

gaia1.description: At the start of the game, Gaia creates a Worldsprout minion instead of a Seedling.

gaia2.description: Channel Earth heals a random ally for 10 HP

gaia3.description: Gaia's minions are created with 10 more maximum HP.

gaia4.description: Each time Channel Vitality is triggered, Gaia gains a stack of Channel Earth.

gaia5.description: Gaia now starts the round with 3 Seedlings

galazax1.description: Galazax can now Channel up to 2 separate copies of The Skies Darken.

galazax2.description: Lightning Strikes now deals 10 damage to the primary target and 5 to all other enemies, and becomes Piercing.

galazax3.description: The Heavens Speak now costs [65] less and no longer cancels Channeled skills.

galazax4.description: Thunder Deafens has its cooldown reduced by 1, but it no longer causes Galazax to ignore damage.

galazax5.description: A random enemy Hero starts each round with 3 stacks of The Storm Builds.

gommar1.description: Iceblood Hammer and Foot of the Mountain now mark a random enemy on use. The following turn, that enemy will take 20 damage.

gommar2.description: While Frost-Covered, Gommar gains 10 points of DR

gommar3.description: Breath of the North now lowers the targets damage by 15, lowered by 5 every time they use a skill.

gommar4.description: After Gommar consumes Frost-Covered, he regains it at the end of his next turn.

gommar5.description: Iceblood Hammer deals 5 less damage and costs one fewer r each time it is used, stacking up to twice.

hector1.description: At the start of each round, Hector automatically casts Burning Blood Serum on Dennis.

hector2.description: Hector's Serum skills cannot be stunned.

hector3.description: Serums now last for 2 additional turns, but their costs are increased by [65].

hector4.description: Dennis the Apprentice begins the game with 20 extra health, and under the effect of a random Serum

hector5.description: Hector may use his Serums on targets other than Dennis once Dennis has died.

jarrik1.description: Blade of Ashes strikes an additional random enemy for 10 damage. Has no effect if Blade of Ashes is AOE.

jarrik2.description: Enemies affected by Blackened Wounds ignore healing for 1 turn.

jarrik3.description: If all enemies affected by Cinderswell are marked by Cinders, they have their non-Strategic skills stunned for 1 turn.

jarrik4.description: Jarrik splits all single-target damage received between him and any active Cinders.

jarrik5.description: While Blade of Dancing Lights is active, Cinder minions ignore harmful skills.

keeper1.description: If Keeper of Fables still has Shield on Tales to Tell after using Page-turner, the targeted enemy is stunned for 1 turn. Page-turner's cooldown is increased by 1.

keeper2.description: If Character Development targets an ally it hasn't targeted yet this round, Keeper of Fables gains Elemental Essence.

keeper3.description: If Keeper of Fables is the only living Hero you control, Hero's Return only consumes 50 Shield and costs one less [65].

keeper4.description: Shield from Tales to Tell can only take a maximum of 20 damage from a single hit.

keeper5.description: If Keeper of Fables doesn't act during his turn, he heals his team for 5 health.

laria1.description: If the target of Nightwrap has 4 Stacks of Deepening Shadows, they become Invulnerable if they are an ally or Stunned if they are an enemy. Effect lasts 1 turn.

laria2.description: If Laria uses Nightwrap on a target without Elemental Essence, she gives them Elemental Essence if they are an ally, and generates a Generic energy if they are an enemy.

laria3.description: Nightwrap now counts stacks of Deepening Shadows on Laria if she is using it on an enemy

laria4.description: Characters with 3 or more stacks of Deepening Shadows Bypass.

laria5.description: When a character receives their 3rd stack of Deepening Shadows, they gain the effects of Vanish.

maggie1.description: When Maggie gains Elemental Essence from Bramblelash, she heals 5 health for every stack of Curse of Thorns on her.

maggie2.description: Bramblelash, Thornburst, and Grasping Vines deal 5 additional damage if Maggie has 2 or more stacks of Curse of Thorns. This damage increases to 10 when she has 4 or more.

maggie3.description: When Maggie's Shield is damaged while Bramblebarrier is active, she deals 5 Piercing damage to the enemy team.

maggie4.description: Enemies stunned by Grasping Vines take 15 more damage from Bramblelash.

maggie5.description: Targets marked by Bramblelash receive 10 additional damage from Thornburst.

pyrrha1.description: Fan the Flames now costs 1 more [65], but deals 5 additional damage per tick.

pyrrha2.description: Pyrrha heals for 10 health any time Fan the Flames expires or is removed.

pyrrha3.description: Pyrokinesis will now consume Fan the Flames to deal 15 extra damage.

pyrrha4.description: Flashbang now fully stuns the targeted enemy

pyrrha5.description: While Wraith in White is active, Pyrrha deals 5 Affliction damage to the enemy team each turn.

riverdaughter1.description: Enemies who have been stunned by Undertow take 10 affliction damage each turn for the rest of the game.

riverdaughter2.description: When Soothe expires, it will attempt to jump to an ally that doesn't currently have it.

riverdaughter3.description: If River Clone expires without being triggered, it will attempt to jump to an ally that doesn't currently have it.

riverdaughter4.description: River Daughter heals 20 health for 2 turns when she uses Dive.

riverdaughter5.description: Whenever River Clone is triggered, River Daughter casts Ripple.

roland1.description: Boulder minions are created with 60 HP.

roland2.description: Earth Pillar marks an additional random enemy each time it is used.

roland3.description: Stoneform now lasts 1 additional turn, and while affected by it, Boulders deal double damage when launched with Strength From The Earth.

roland4.description: Boulders are now created with 25 less HP. If Roland destroys a Boulder with Strength From The Earth, he deals 25 Piercing damage to all enemies.

roland5.description: Form Stone now creates two Boulders at a time.

saya1.description: When Saya gives an ally Elemental Essence with Universal Energy Conduit, she also gains Elemental Essence

saya2.description: Saya Coil deals an additional 5 damage for every Saya Coil she has active

saya3.description: Spider Mines now affects a single enemy, but only lasts for one turn.

saya4.description: Reduces the cooldown of Plasma Shield to 1 turn, but reduces the shield it grants to 25.

saya5.description: Well-Used Panic Button will now trigger when Saya falls below 60 health.

scratch1.description: Allies receive 10 Affliction damage when triggering Scratch's Deal skills, but they gain Elemental Essence when doing so.

scratch2.description: Heroes affected by Deal: Defeat Your Enemies ignore stuns and counters.

scratch3.description: Each round, the first time Scratch falls below 30 HP, his next non-Ultimate Deal skill applies all other non-Ultimate Deal skills.

scratch4.description: Scratch's Deal skills no longer have a cooldown, but can only affect each Hero once per round.

scratch5.description: Deal: Defeat Your Enemies and Deal: Save Your Friends are now invisible until triggered.

sera1.description: Synthetic Skyblade deals 5 additional base damage, costs an additional Generic, and will consume 2 stacks of Eyes of Vengeance.

sera2.description: Enemies targeted by Heavenly Parry deal 10 reduced damage for their next turn. This effect is invisible.

sera3.description: If Energized Wingstorm consumes 3 or more stacks of Eyes of Vengeance, it will deal an additional 15 Piercing damage to each target the following turn.

sera4.description: Proactivity Protocol now deals 15 normal Damage and heals for 25, but gains an additional 1 turn cooldown.

sera5.description: Divinity Engine lasts an additional turn for each of Sera's dead allies.

syl1.description: Successfully healing Syl's Eagle Minion with Feed lowers the cost of Leyline Nest by [4] until the next time it is used.

syl2.description: To the Skies! now lasts an additional turn.

syl3.description: Enemies stunned by Talon Rake receive 15 damage when the stun ends.

syl4.description: Unbreakable Bond now heals Syl and her Eagle for 10 health after health has been equalized.

syl5.description: Skylance now heals Syl's Eagle minion for 10 health. If her Eagle minion is at maximum life after the heal, she gains Elemental Essence.

taryn1.description: Inspiring Thrust now targets all enemies but has an additional 1 turn cooldown.

taryn2.description: Protector of the Song now also triggers when Taryn is stunned or countered.

taryn3.description: Taryn's Strategic skills cannot be stunned.

taryn4.description: Allies affected by Refrain reflect harmful they receive to Taryn.

taryn5.description: Refrain will now target a random ally when used on an enemy, or a random enemy when used on an ally.

titania1.description: Allies affected by Laughing Powder also gain the effects of Whimsy.

titania2.description: Enemies under the effect of Barbed Wit now receive 15 Affliction damage when they use a Harmful skill on Titania, and Barbed Wit no longer ends when this occurs.

titania3.description: Thorn Prick no longer deals initial damage, but its affliction damage is doubled.

titania4.description: Titania starts each round with a Summer Courtesan, but her maximum is reduced to 1.

titania5.description: If Prance is triggered by one of Titania's allies, the following turn, the other ally will have their basic abilities' Specific costs changed to Generic

trinity1.description: Prisma Maneuver skills mark Prisma Scarlet for 3 turns when she uses them or they are used on her. If she is marked by all 3 Prisma Maneuver skills, Crimson Crash deals 40 more damage.

trinity2.description: Prisma Whirl now applies Sonata Azure instead of its normal effect.

trinity3.description: Saffron Beam now affects all enemies, but using it Shatters Prisma Saffron for 1 turn.

trinity4.description: Prisma Lens skills deal 0 damage to their target, increased by 5 for each other Lens skill already used on them this turn.

trinity5.description: At the start of each round, a random Prismari Ranger has their maximum HP increased by 20.

xyris1.description: Reveal Hidden Truth lowers its targets damage dealt by 10 for 1 turn.

xyris2.description: Xyris gains 5 permanent Shield each time he gains Elemental Essence.

xyris3.description: If Xyris has Elemental Essence when he uses Enter the Dreamscape, its cooldown is set to 1.

xyris4.description: Twisted Nightmares becomes permanent if used on an enemy affected by Enter the Dreamscape.

xyris5.description: Dream Reflection minions are created with the countered enemy's current HP.

zephyrex1.description: If Arcadian Duet targets a different enemy than its last target, Zephyrex gains Elemental Essence.

zephyrex2.description: Using Sonic Thrust on an enemy will also use Arcadian Duet on them.

zephyrex3.description: Wind Step now targets an enemy, lowering their non-Affliction damage by 10 for 1 turn. If that enemy uses a new harmful skill during this time, Zephyrex gains Elemental Essence. This effect is invisible.

zephyrex4.description: Perfection now grants Zephyrex immunity to Stuns.

zephyrex5.description: Elegant Sweep is now invisible, and Zephyrex gains the effect of Wind Step while it is active.

zevkir1.description: While Zev'kir is Channelling Call Tides, he heals 5 HP per turn and ignores stuns.

zevkir2.description: If Zev'kir has 2 or more stacks of Call Tides, Bubble Prison increases affected enemy skill costs by 1 [65]. If he has 4 or more stacks, they are increased by 1 Energy of the target's Element instead.

zevkir3.description: If Zev'kir has 2 or more stacks of Call Tides, Riptide deals Piercing damage. If he has 4 or more stacks, it deals Affliction damage instead.

zevkir4.description: Tidal Wave deals 20 less damage, but its base cost is reduced by 2 Specific energy

zevkir5.description: While Repulse is not on cooldown, Zev'kir gains 15 Shield that replenishes at the start of his turn.
